args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Replace the default base URL for password reset email links from "http://localhost:3000" to use the PUBLIC_URL environment variable as the base. This fixes the issue where the reset password email link was pointing to localhost instead of the actual deployment URL, which caused confusion and made the link unusable for users outside the development environment.
args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct public URL
